notes: From the FY2024 Form 10-K. DuPont reports manufacturing sites and employee shares by four regions only; 'U.S. & Canada' is defined by its name, the other regions have no country list (EMEA is footnoted as Europe, Middle East, and Africa). Site totals can count a site more than once when several segments use it. Employee shares are percentages of approximately 24,000 and are not converted into headcounts. Long-lived assets are filed separately for the United States and Canada, so they sit on country rows while the 'U.S. & Canada' region carries sites and employees. The 10-K names only the Wilmington headquarters; no list of plants, no state breakdown and no country-by-country tax report were found in it.
